repository_check.scope: Structure, exact prompts, package/reference closure, public surface and preservation; not research quality or installation.

pack_structure.method: Loaded both pack.json files; checked eight dimensions, seven effects, sixteen cases, no dependencies, contained existing entry paths, MIT bytes and Markdown link closure using existing repository link helper.

required_case_outputs.scope: All declared output paths; substantive execution and limits remain in separate case reports/audits.

controls.scope: Separate agent producer/evaluator semantic controls; no runtime loader or installed proof.

staged_snapshot_scan.disposition: Formatting-only diagnostics in literal first-party source snapshots, CSV CRLF records and previously fixed/audited research report bytes. Preserve exact evidence bytes and audit identities; do not normalize them for a style check. No validator or Git whitespace rule changed.

limits: Individual unsupported conclusions and inherited discovery-trace gaps remain explicit.
One development rerun cannot establish a stable effect or global pack superiority.
exit: PASS: Stage 20 content and conformance; publication requires verification of the resulting commit and remote ref

links.scope: Current public examples, all progressive Markdown, stage records and contained production pack links.
